What is the ratio of the total number of girls in all the subjects to that of boys in all the subjects?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total number of girls in Hindi = 110 × 0.6 = 66

Total number of boys in Hindi = 110 × 0.4 = 44

Total number of girls in English = 70 × 0.5 = 35

Total number of boys in English = 70 × 0.5 = 35

Total number of girls in Physics = 50 × 0.3 = 15

Total number of boys in Physics = 50 × 0.7 = 35

Total number of girls in Chemistry = 40 × 0.8 = 32

Total number of boys in Chemistry = 40 × 0.2 = 8

Total number of girls in Mathematics = 80 × 0.2 = 16

Total number of boys in Mathematics = 80 × 0.8 = 64

Total number of girls in Computers = 90 × 0.4 = 36

Total number of boys in Computers = 90 × 0.6 = 54

Total number of girls = 66 + 35 + 15 + 32 + 16 + 36 = 200

Total number of boys = 44 + 35 + 35 + 8 + 64 + 54 = 240

Ratio = 200 : 240 = 5 : 6

**∴ The required answer is 5 : 6.**
